original: ふん。\nそんなんだから、\nキールは泣き虫ベソかきって言われんだ
traducao: Hmph.\nThat's why everyone calls\nKeele a big crybaby.

original: い、言いがかりだ！\n誰もぼくをそんな風に言ったりしないぞ
traducao: Th-That's completely baseless!\nNo one calls me that at all!

original: はいはい、ケンカはそこまで
traducao: Okay, okay, that's enough fighting.

original: もう。\nいつまでつまんない\n言い合いを続けるつもり？
traducao: Geez.\nHow long do you two plan\nto keep this silly argument going?

original: ワイール！\nメルディ知ってるよ
traducao: WA-IRU!\nMeredy knows!

original: オトコが黙って、\nセーセードードー勝負するべし。\n……な？
traducao: Men should stay quiet and\nfight fair and square.\n...Right?

original: 勝負だぁ？
traducao: A fight?

original: また脈絡のない事を\n言い出したぞ……
traducao: She's saying things with\nno context again...

original: いいじゃない、面白そう！\nね、狩りの勝負なんかはどう？
traducao: Why not? Sounds fun!\nHey, how about a hunting contest?

original: どっちが多く獲物を仕留められるか。\n公平だし、わかりやすいでしょ
traducao: See who can hunt the most prey.\nIt's fair and simple to understand, right?

original: ぼくは反対だ！
traducao: I'm against this!

original: そもそも学生のぼくが、\nどうしてそんな馬鹿げた事に\n付き合わなきゃならないんだ
traducao: Why should I, an academic,\nhave to tag along for\nsomething so completely ridiculous?

original: 自信がないんだな
traducao: You just don't have any confidence.

original: 違う！\n学生の本分は勉学だと言っているんだ！
traducao: Wrong!\nI'm saying a student's duty is to study!

original: メルディが狩り、手伝うな！\n三人と三人なら、ビョウドウ
traducao: Meredy will help hunt!\nThree against three, perfectly equal!

original: メルディと、キールと、クィッキー。\nあと、ファラとリッドと\n○○
traducao: Meredy, Keele, and Quickie.\nAnd Farah, Reid, and\n○○.

original: これで三人ずつ。\nビョウドウな！\n楽しいよー
traducao: Now it's three against three.\nEqual!\nIt'll be fun!

original: 冗談だろ？\nこっちは三人じゃないじゃないか！
traducao: Are you joking?\nWe don't even have three people!

original: クィック、クィッキー！！
traducao: Quik, Quickie!!

original: ダイジョーブ！\nクィッキー手伝う言ってるな
traducao: It's okay!\nQuickie says he'll help!

original: そうじゃない。\nぼくが言いたいのは……
traducao: That's not it.\nWhat I want to say is...

original: 決まりだな
traducao: It's decided.

original: だね
traducao: Yep.

original: じゃ、○○。\n都合のいい時に\n声をかけてもらってもいい？
traducao: Well then, ○○.\nLet us know when\nyou're ready to go, alright?

original: その時から、勝負スタートって事で！
traducao: When you do, the contest starts!

original: だから、勝手に話を進めるなぁ〜！
traducao: I said, stop deciding things on your own!

original: クエスト「負けられない戦い」が\nエントリーされました。\nファラから受ける事が出来ます
traducao: Quest "An Unbeatable Battle" has\nbeen entered.\nYou can accept it from Farah.

original: ワイール！\n○○、待ってたよぅ
traducao: WA-IRU!\n○○, we were waiting!

original: 悪いな。\nお前も暇じゃねえのに、\nくだらねえ事に巻き込んじまって
traducao: My bad.\nI know you're busy, but we\nended up dragging you into this nonsense.

original: 悪いと思うなら、\nやめればいいだろ
traducao: If you feel bad,\nthen we should just cancel this.

original: それとこれとは、話が別だ
traducao: That's a completely different matter.

original: ルールは確認してもらった通りだよ。\n先に決められた数の獲物を倒した方が勝ち。\nいいよね？
traducao: The rules are as we confirmed.\nThe first to hunt the target amount wins.\nSound good?

original: 早速出発するな！\nメルディ楽しみ♪
traducao: Let's head out right away!\nMeredy is excited!

original: キール、何持ってく？\nバナナおやつ入るか？
traducao: Keele, what will you bring?\nDo we have room for banana snacks?

original: ……本当に何しに行くか、\nわかってるのか？
traducao: ...Do you even realize\nwhat we're going to do?

original: よし。\nサクッと狩って、\nキールをあっと言わせてやろうぜ
traducao: Alright.\nLet's hunt 'em up quick\nand leave Keele totally speechless.

original: リッドったら、張り切っちゃって
traducao: Reid, you're so fired up.

original: 当たり前だろ。\n狩りの腕で、オレがキールに負けるもんか
traducao: Of course I am.\nNo way I'd lose to Keele at hunting.

original: 勉強では負けっぱなしだけどね
traducao: You always lose when it comes to studying.

original: う、うるせえ
traducao: Sh-Shut up!

original: よし。\nこの調子でいこうぜ
traducao: Alright.\nLet's keep this pace up.

original: ウィンドカッター！
traducao: Wind Blade!

original: ワイール！　仕留めたよぅ。\nキールすごいな！
traducao: WA-IRU! We took it down.\nKeele is amazing!

original: フン。\nこれくらい造作もないさ
traducao: Hmph.\nThis is nothing for me.

original: クィッククィック、クィッキー！！
traducao: Quik-quik, Quickie!!

original: これなら、リッド達にも負けないよー。\nクィッキーもそう言ってる
traducao: With this, we won't lose to Reid's team!\nQuickie says so too.

original: 当たり前だろう。\nぼくを誰だと思っているんだ
traducao: Obviously.\nWho do you think I am?

original: あいつ、調子いい事言ってんな
traducao: He sure is acting all high and mighty.

original: うん。\nでもあの様子だと、そろそろ……
traducao: Yeah.\nBut by the looks of it, soon...

original: キール！　なぜ転ぶか？\nだいじょぶか
traducao: Keele! Why did you fall?\nAre you okay?

original: う……うるさい！\nちょっと大きな石につまづいただけだ
traducao: Sh... Shut up!\nI just tripped over a slightly large rock.

original: 休憩するか？
traducao: Should we rest?

original: 必要ない
traducao: I don't need to.

original: ……でも、血出てるな。\n無理しないがいいよ
traducao: ...But you're bleeding.\nYou shouldn't push yourself.

original: いいって言ってるだろ！\nよ、寄るな、触るな！
traducao: I told you I'm fine!\nD-Don't get close, don't touch me!

original: 何だよー！！\n心配した、なぜ怒るか？
traducao: What's your deal?!\nMeredy was just worried, why so angry?

original: あいつ、ほんと体力ねえよなぁ
traducao: That guy seriously lacks stamina.

original: でも、油断してたら負けちゃうよ
traducao: But if we let our guard down, we'll lose.

original: よぉし。\nわたし達も頑張ろ！\nイケるイケる！
traducao: Alright.\nLet's do our best too!\nWe can do it!

original: だんだんゴールが見えて来たね
traducao: The goal is coming into view.

original: この調子なら勝てそう。\nうん、イケるイケる！
traducao: At this rate, we can win.\nYeah, we can totally do this!

original: イケるのは結構だけどよ……
traducao: That's all fine and well, but...

original: いたっ……！
traducao: Ouch...!

original: やっぱりな。\n今の戦闘で足、ひねったんだろ？
traducao: I knew it.\nYou twisted your ankle in that last fight?

original: ったく、無理すんなよな
traducao: Geez, don't push yourself so hard.

original: これくらい！　何でもないよ
traducao: This is nothing! I'm completely fine!

original: ファラ。\nオレ達は今、三人で戦ってるんだぞ？
traducao: Farah.\nWe're fighting as a team of three now.

original: お前一人が\n背負い込む事ねえんだ
traducao: There's no need for you\nto shoulder the burden all on your own.

original: リッド……。\n○○まで……
traducao: Reid...\nAnd even ○○...

original: そだね。\nみんなもいるんだもんね。\n無理はしないよ、大丈夫
traducao: You're right.\nI have everyone with me.\nI won't overdo it, I'm okay!

original: しんどくなったら言えよ
traducao: Tell us if it gets too rough.

original: うん。\nありがと
traducao: Yeah.\nThanks.

original: やった！\n今ので目標達成だよ！！
traducao: We did it!\nThat completes our goal!!

original: こんくらい、チョロイもんだぜ
traducao: This much was a piece of cake.

original: キール達、どうしてるかな。\nもう帰ってたりして……
traducao: I wonder how Keele's team is doing.\nMaybe they went back already...

original: ま、戻ってみりゃわかるだろ。\nさっさと獲物をまとめて帰ろうぜ
traducao: Well, we'll see once we head back.\nLet's pack up our prey and go home.

original: うん。\nそうだね
traducao: Yeah.\nLet's go.

original: ふん、遅かったじゃないか
traducao: Hmph, you took your sweet time.

original: キール！？
traducao: Keele!?

original: えっ、もう戻って来てたの？
traducao: Huh, you're back already?

original: すっごーい！　早かったんだね
traducao: Amazing! You guys were so fast!

original: クィ？
traducao: Quik?

original: ま、まぁな……
traducao: W-Well, yeah...

original: それ違うよ
traducao: That's not right.

original: キール転んで、パンツ破けた。\nだから替え取りに来たよ
traducao: Keele fell and ripped his pants.\nSo we came to get a spare.

original: メルディ！！
traducao: Meredy!!

original: ほ〜う……、パンツが破けたのか。\nそりゃ大変だったなぁ、キール？
traducao: Oho... So your pants ripped.\nThat must have been awful, Keele.

original: 違う！\n破けたのは衣服で、\n下着なんかじゃ……
traducao: Wrong!\nWhat tore was my outer garments,\nnot my underwear...

original: じゃ、どしてパンツ押さえたよ？
traducao: Then why were you holding your pants?

original: だ、だからお前は、パンツパンツ言うな！
traducao: I-I told you to stop saying pants!

original: キール、破れたパンツどこ？\n繕ってあげるから、出しておいてね
traducao: Keele, where are your torn pants?\nI'll sew them up, so bring them out.

original: あ、メルディもパンツ手伝う！\nボタン付け教えて欲しいよー
traducao: Ah, Meredy will help with the pants too!\nI want to learn how to sew on a button!

original: 良かったな、キール。\n思い出のパンツが出来そうで
traducao: Good for you, Keele.\nYou'll get some memorable pants.

original: クィック、クィキキキ
traducao: Quik, quikikiki.

original: ううぅ……。\nだから、違うのに……
traducao: Uuurgh...\nI told you, that's not it...

original: 何か、勝負の結果は\nあやふやになっちゃったね……
traducao: Somehow, the contest's results\nended up a bit ambiguous...

original: でも、○○が\n手伝ってくれて嬉しかったよ。\nすごく助かっちゃった
traducao: But I was really happy that\n○○ helped us out.\nIt was a huge help.

original: ありがと！
traducao: Thanks!
